scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling about the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a while back and I was wondering if you could update me on where it stands. Was my application approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your application was denied. The reasons for denial listed in your record are "Other", "Debt-to-income ratio", and "Credit history".

dialogue.user: I'm not sure what to make of that. Can you tell me a bit more about what "Other" refers to? And what specifically about my debt-to-income ratio and credit history led to the denial? I want to understand what I can do differently if I reapply.
dialogue.agent: The record doesn't provide further details on the "Other" reason or the specific aspects of your debt-to-income ratio and credit history that contributed to the denial. It only lists these as the reasons. The debt-to-income ratio was 39%.

dialogue.user: That's not very helpful. A 39% debt-to-income ratio doesn't sound that bad. I'm still in the dark about what I can do to improve my chances of getting approved next time. Can you at least tell me what my interest rate would have been if my application had been approved? And were there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate is not specified in your loan record. Additionally, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and there is no negative amortization feature associated with your loan.

dialogue.user: I see. Well, I appreciate you trying to help me understand. It sounds like I don't have much to go on to improve my application for next time. Can you tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product I would have been approved for if my application had been approved?
dialogue.agent: The record indicates that the purchaser type is not applicable, as the loan was denied. The loan product type would have been a Conventional:Subordinate Lien. That is all the information available in your record on those topics.

dialogue.user: I think I've got all the information I can get from you. It's been helpful, but I'm still a bit frustrated that I don't have a clearer understanding of why my application was denied. I'm going to rate this interaction as <Dissatisfied> because I felt like I didn't get enough specific information to help me understand what went wrong and how to improve for next time. The reasons for denial were vague, and I had to ask multiple questions to get even basic information.
